column1: # G12 phase 6: nof(n, ...c), the count of the alternatives that
# already admit a value (docs/reference-language.md, `Band B: nof`,
# ADR-046). Every expectation was obtained by running both engines and
# The count is an integer or a count constraint, the algebra len reads,
# and an alternative is counted when it admits the value.
# A scalar of any kind, a boolean and null included, is decided at the
# meet; a nil alternative admits nothing and any admits everything.
# A map or list is decided at generation. An alternative admits it when
# meeting it adds no member generation would emit: a required key, a
# resolved optional one and a default are all members the value lacks.

column3: a: {&: nof(min(1), integer, string)} & {p: 1, q: true}

column1: # Canon: the alternatives are sorted and never deduplicated, since a
# count counts duplicates; atoms are one per canon, sorted by canon, and
# write after must. A number residual holding only Band B atoms names

column3: a: nof(1, string, integer) & nof(1, integer, string)

column1: # Refusals of the atom itself. A count needs at least one alternative
# beside it, and an effectful alternative is refused as must refuses it.
# Before generation a count refuses only what no member could change: an
# alternative whose meet is already empty never admits.
# A trial settles the counts its alternative holds, in a map or a list,
# and a count held in a referenced spread is read through the reference.

column3: T: hide(nof(1, string, integer))\na: {&: $.T} & {p: "p", q: true}

column1: # G12 phase 12 (use-cases/BUGS.md, 111): a container a check holds, met
# with one more term, stays a held container, where the conjunct kept
# three terms apart and could not generate. Both engines agree.

column3: x: (null|(map & nof(1, {a: any}))) & nof(1, {z: any}) & {a: 1, z: 1}
x: nof(1, {a: any}) & nof(1, {b: any}) & {a: 1, b: 2}

column1: # G12 phase 12 (use-cases/BUGS.md, 112): a check whose trial is an alias
# still settling meets one already built by settling against it, where
# it met the built one as empty and the container could not generate.

column3: %one = nof(1, %two, {b: any})\n%two = nof(1, {c: any}, {d: any})\nx: (null|(map & nof(1, %one, {q: any}))) & nof(1, %one, {a: any}) & {b: 1}
%one = nof(1, %two, {b: any})\n%two = nof(1, {c: any}, {d: any})\nx: (null|(map & when(%one, {b: 1}))) & nof(1, %one, {a: any}) & {b: 1}
%one = nof(1, %two, {b: any})\n%two = nof(1, {c: any}, {d: any})\nx: (null|(map & when(%one, {b: 2}))) & nof(1, %one, {a: any}) & {b: 1}
